table bridge openuf_learn {
	set portmacs {
		type ifname . ether_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 5m
		elements = { "lan2" . 00:00:5e:00:53:07 expires 4m43s880ms,
			     "lan3" . 00:00:5e:00:53:08 expires 4m59s990ms,
			     "lan2" . 00:00:5e:00:53:09 expires 1m2s }
	}

	set portips {
		type ifname . ether_addr . ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 5m
		elements = { "lan2" . 00:00:5e:00:53:07 . 192.0.2.20 expires 4m43s880ms,
			     "lan2" . 00:00:5e:00:53:09 . 192.0.2.99 expires 44s990ms,
			     "lan2" . 00:00:5e:00:53:09 . 192.0.2.22 expires 1m2s }
	}

	chain learn {
		type filter hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "lan2" update @portmacs { iifname . ether saddr }
		iifname "lan2" arp saddr ip != 0.0.0.0 update @portips { iifname . ether saddr . arp saddr ip }
		iifname "lan2" ip saddr != 0.0.0.0 update @portips { iifname . ether saddr . ip saddr }
	}
}
